thread:
Alex Rivera: Hi everyone — unboxed a Surface Pro from ops and trying to complete Autopilot / Azure AD join. The setup loop fails with "Device not present in Autopilot service" and Docker Desktop needs admin. Also my SSH key isn't being accepted on our internal Git host. Blocked on getting up and running.
Nina Patel: Welcome Alex! Can you share the device serial and whether this was marked as Autopilot-ready in the asset ticket? Also what Wi‑Fi are you on — corp-wifi or home?
Alex Rivera: Serial: 02-79-AB-4F
Alex Rivera: I'm on corp-wifi (office). Asset ticket said "Autopilot provisioning: yes" but I don't see the device in https://autopilot.redwood.internal (NET::ERR_CERT) — browser shows cert error.
Raj Shah: Sounds like two things: (1) cert chain for internal console missing on the device, causing the portal to error, and (2) the device might not be tagged in Autopilot or the hardware hash didn't upload. Can you run: `dsregcmd /status` and paste the output (no sensitive tokens)?
Alex Rivera: I can't run that: System prompts for admin when I try to open elevated cmd. Fresh OOBE with no local admin.
Nina Patel: We normally use LAPS to grant 15‑30m local admin for onboarding sessions. @IT Bot — can you open a temporary admin request for Alex and also check if serial 02-79-AB-4F is present in Autopilot?
IT Bot: Ticket created — ONB-2026-3378. Requested temporary local admin (LAPS) for Alex Rivera. Checking Autopilot records... Not found in Autopilot catalog. Marked for manual hardware-hash import.
Raj Shah: If Autopilot isn't in the service, ops may have skipped the hardware hash upload. Two options: ops re-upload the hash, or we can run the provisioning package during the LAPS window and join manually. Which do you prefer Alex?
Alex Rivera: I'd like to get going today if possible. Manual during LAPS window is fine. I'm available 14:00 PT.
Nina Patel: OK booked. Quick pre-checks: before the session we'll need the device online and a camera for assistance. Also, SSH key: did you add your public key to your GitHub/Redwood account? If not, paste `~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` content in DM to me and I'll add it to the internal account to save time.
Alex Rivera: I didn't add it yet. Will paste in a DM now.
Onboarding Bot: Reminder — please do not save personal files on the device before LAPS session.
Alex Rivera: DM sent with SSH pubkey. Thanks.
Raj Shah: During the session we'll: 1) grant local admin via LAPS, 2) import corporate root CA, 3) re-open the Autopilot portal to confirm and run `dsregcmd /join` if needed, 4) verify BitLocker auto-provisioning (escrow to Azure AD), 5) install Docker Desktop for WSL2 and enable Hyper-V features.
IT Bot: LAPS password issued for user Alex Rivera, expires in 30 minutes at 14:30 PT.
Alex Rivera: Remote session done — Raj walked me through, LAPS admin applied, root CA installed, ops re-uploaded hardware hash while I was connected. Ran `dsregcmd /status` and it now shows AzureAdJoined : YES. BitLocker auto-provisioned and recovery key is in Azure AD. Docker Desktop installed and WSL2 enabled. SSH key works for internal git.
Nina Patel: Amazing — welcome aboard Alex :tada: Let us know if you want a quick walkthrough of our local dev environment setup or dotfiles.
Alex Rivera: Thanks everyone, appreciate the help! :wave:
